# hermes-maintainer

> Local-first maintenance intelligence for `NousResearch/hermes-agent`. Python CLI + FastAPI dashboard over a SQLite/FTS5 backlog graph. GitHub access is **read-only**; this tool does not close issues or merge PRs.

hermes-maintainer turns issues and PRs into a typed campaign graph: survivors, donors, stacked children, and superseded work. The local dashboard uses the Hermes Teal palette (with additional built-in Hermes themes) and an [xyflow](https://xyflow.com) explorer. Default listen address: `http://127.0.0.1:8766`.

Do not collapse `similar`, `duplicate_of`, `same_root_cause`, `partially_addresses`, and `supersedes` into one relation. kvnloo has pull-only access on hermes-agent (foreign closes return 403).

## Code

- [CLI](./src/hermes_maintainer/cli.py): `init`, `scan`, `analyze`, `serve`, `daemon`, `doctor`, `report`
- [FastAPI app](./src/hermes_maintainer/api/app.py): `/api/graph`, campaign explorer, `/llms.txt`
- [Graph store](./src/hermes_maintainer/graph/store.py): typed edges, subgraph export, filters
- [Campaign builder](./src/hermes_maintainer/analysis/campaigns.py): survivor/donor/provenance roles
- [xyflow graph UI](./src/hermes_maintainer/ui/graph-src/graph-app.jsx): clickable architecture + campaign canvases (bundled to `ui/static/graph-app.js`)
- [Dashboard theme](./src/hermes_maintainer/ui/static/styles.css): Hermes Teal and sibling palettes
- [SQLite schema](./src/hermes_maintainer/schema.sql): nodes, relations, FTS5, campaigns, fix atoms
